description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mawaturagama, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320044
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and other land-specific particulars. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and title registration, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
